title: 第23章 一百个耳光第24章 两个不同世界的人
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
“先去圆月学宫看看周木和青洛。”
走出叶家，叶云飞心有挂牵，抬步向圆月学宫走去。
到目前为止，周木是叶云飞心中最认可的兄弟。
苏青洛是叶云飞最感激的女孩。
圆月学宫之中，校道之上，学员们来来往往，十分热闹。
学宫对学员的管理，并不严格。
上不上课，上哪一个武师的课，完全是学员们自己的选择。
甚至，有一些武道世家的子弟，交了学费之后，极少来学宫，完全呆在自己的家族之中修武。
这种管理的理念，据说，与学宫之主有关。
不过，学宫之主，是一个十分神秘的人物。
极少露面。
“叶家的人，全部都给我跪下！
叩一百个响头。”
突然，一道充满轻蔑味道的声音响起。
“哦？”
叶云飞抬头，向前方望去。
前方围着一大堆学员，里里外外，挤得密不透风。
人群的中间，留出一大片空地。
有两派年轻人，正在对峙。
其中一派，每一个都被打得鼻肿脸青，甚至手脚折断，鲜血淋淋，有点凄凉。

“施少杰，你太过分了！
你这样为难我们，就不怕引起我们叶家的怒火！”
其中一个左手手腕被折断，露出白森森断骨的少年，正捧着断手，用悲愤的声音质问。
“叶家即将覆灭，有什么好怕的。”
一个黄衫少年，傲然挺立，脸上充满不屑之色，冷笑着说道。
这个黄衫少年，叫施少杰！
施小蝶的亲弟，圆月城施家的少爷。
施少杰有着炼体八重的实力，是施家年轻一代的领军人物，也是圆月城一代的风云人物之一。
据说，在圆月城年轻一代，他能排进前五名！
十几个神色嚣张的少年，站在施少杰的两旁，一个个显得凶神恶煞。
这些少年全部都是施家的。
“本来，我今天是专门来找叶云飞那个废物的，他居然敢当众写下休书，侮辱我姐。
罪该万死。
既然叶云飞那个废物今天没有来学宫，那么他的罪孽就只好由你们来承担。”
施少杰双手抱胸，冷冷说道。
content_en:
"Go to Yuanyue Academy to see Zhou Mu and Qingluo first."
After walking out of Ye's house, Ye Yunfei felt worried and walked towards Yuanyue Academy.
So far, Zhou Mu is Ye Yunfei's most recognized brother.
Su Qingluo is the girl that Ye Yunfei is most grateful for.
In Yuanyue Academy and on the school road, students were coming and going, making it very lively.
The Academy's management of students is not strict.
Whether or not to attend classes, and which martial arts master's class to attend, is entirely the student's own choice.
There are even some children from martial arts families who, after paying their tuition, rarely come to the academy and stay entirely within their own families to practice martial arts.
This concept of management is said to be related to the master of the academy.
However, the master of the academy is a very mysterious figure.
Rarely seen.
"Everyone from the Ye family, please kneel down!
Kowtow a hundred times. "
Suddenly, a voice full of contempt sounded.
"Oh?"
Ye Yunfei raised his head and looked forward.
There were a large number of students surrounding the front, packed inside and out.
There was a large open space in the middle of the crowd.
There are two groups of young people confronting each other.
In one group, everyone was beaten until their noses were swollen and their faces were bruised, and their hands and feet were even broken. They were bloody and a bit desolate.
"Shi Shaojie, you have gone too far!
If you embarrass us like this, you are not afraid of arousing the anger of our Ye family! "
One of the young men, whose left wrist was broken, exposing his broken bones, was holding the severed hand and questioning in a sad and angry voice.
"The Ye family is about to be destroyed. There is nothing to be afraid of."
A young man in a yellow shirt stood proudly, his face full of disdain, and said with a sneer.
This boy in yellow shirt is called Shi Shaojie!
Shi Xiaodie's biological brother and the young master of the Shi family in Yuanyue City.
Shi Shaojie has the strength of the eighth level of physical training. He is the leader of the younger generation of the Shi family and one of the most influential figures in Yuanyue City.
It is said that among the younger generation in Yuanyue City, he can rank among the top five!
A dozen arrogant-looking teenagers stood on both sides of Shi Shaojie, each of them looking fierce.
All these teenagers are from the Shi family.
"Originally, I came specifically to see that good-for-nothing Ye Yunfei today, but he actually dared to write a letter of divorce in public and insult my sister.
The sin deserves death.
Since that good-for-nothing Ye Yunfei didn't come to the academy today, you have to bear his sins. "
Shi Shaojie crossed his arms and said coldly.
